subject: Supplier portal invite blocked by IDP: SAML assertion replay detected
messages:
From: Olivia Grant <olivia@ravenmaterials.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Unable to accept supplier portal invite - SAML assertion replay error

Hi Evelyn / Ben,

We received the invitation to Redwood's supplier portal this morning but when our user (paul.jenkins@ravenmaterials.com) clicks Accept they see an error page: "SAML assertion replay detected" and the session is rejected. We've tried clearing cookies, using an incognito window, and a different browser, but no luck.

I attached the raw SAML response (saml_response.txt) and we captured a short HAR from Chrome. Can you confirm whether this is on our IdP side (Azure AD) or something expected on your SP? This is blocking our PO onboarding for this week.

Thanks,
Olivia Grant
Procurement Manager
Raven Materials
procurement@ravenmaterials.com
Attachment: saml_response.txt (text/plain, 12 KB)

-----Original Message-----

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia@ravenmaterials.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Aug 2028 09:45:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Unable to accept supplier portal invite - SAML assertion replay error

Hi Olivia — thanks for the quick note and the logs. Really sorry you're hitting this. I'm looping in Ben (SRE) and Karthik (Onboarding) to troubleshoot.

Proposed next steps:
- Ben: can you take a look at the SAML response and the SP logs?
- Karthik: if we need a temporary bypass (manual claim), can you coordinate with Raven to accept the PO flow while we fix the IdP behavior?
- Olivia: can you confirm the IdP configuration (single sign-on URL / issuer) and whether you pushed any conditional access changes this morning?

If helpful, we can do a quick 20-minute screen-share at 10:30 PT today. Are you available?

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0123

On Fri, Aug 11, 2028 at 10:02 AM, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com> wrote:

> Hi all — I pulled the saml_response.txt from Olivia's attachment and compared it with the SP logs. Two quick findings:
>
> 1) The SAML Response includes an Assertion with an Id of "_a7f4f1e9" and an InResponseTo value that matches the SP request id. However, our replay cache is rejecting it because the same Assertion Id appeared twice within a short window; the IdP appears to be reusing Assertion IDs for replays (Azure has a bug where a proxy can strip the randomness).
>
> 2) The SP (supplier portal) currently enforces a strict replay check and rejects duplicate Assertion IDs in <= 60s. We log: "SAML: assertion rejected - possible replay (id=_a7f4f1e9)" in /var/log/sp/saml.log. I attached a zipped extract of the relevant logs.
>
> Short-term workaround:
> - Karthik can create a manual claim for paul.jenkins@ravenmaterials.com so the invite is accepted in the portal without the SAML assertion (manual enrollment).
> - Alternatively we can temporarily relax the replay cache for this vendor ID for 30 minutes while Raven retries. That's riskier but possible for a single vendor.
>
> Long-term fix:
> - We should accept unsolicited SAML responses from Raven's IdP or make our replay cache tolerant for known partner IdPs that have this proxy behavior.
> - Also ask Raven to check any proxy or gateway in front of Azure AD that might be rewriting assertion IDs.
>
> I uploaded idp-logs.zip with the relevant SP entries.
>
> - Ben Carter
> SRE, Redwood Inference
> Attachment: idp-logs.zip (application/zip, 420 KB)

On Fri, Aug 11, 2028 at 10:15 AM, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com> wrote:
